translatorNotes: FLAG: legal-ethics jurisdiction sensitivity. This post is written around the US model of legal ethics: 'unauthorized practice of law', attorney-client confidentiality, Clio's US 'Legal Trends Report' secret-shopper data, and 'attorney'. In German-speaking markets the equivalents differ (Germany: Rechtsdienstleistungsgesetz / unerlaubte Rechtsberatung; anwaltliche Verschwiegenheitspflicht per BRAO/BORA; Austria and Switzerland differ again). 'unauthorized practice of law' was rendered as 'unerlaubte Rechtsberatung' as the nearest lay term, but a German-qualified reviewer (ideally with legal-marketing compliance knowledge for the target jurisdiction) must confirm the ethics and confidentiality wording before publishing, since anwaltliche Werbung and Verschwiegenheit are strictly regulated.

Glossary terms applied: client intake -> Mandatsannahme; law firm -> Kanzlei; attorney -> Anwalt; consultation -> Beratungsgespräch; legal advice -> Rechtsberatung. 'client'/'prospective client' -> Mandant/Interessent; 'retainer'/'retained client' -> Mandat/gewonnenes Mandat; 'matter' -> Anliegen; 'paralegal' -> Anwaltsfachangestellte. Clio kept literal.
Statistics kept exact: 33%, 40%, 56%, 48%, 73%, 42 Prozent. Timeframes kept: unter 60 Sekunden, unter einer Minute, zwei bis vier Wochen.
Prices kept exact with German thousands separator: '1.000 und 5.000 US-Dollar', '50 bis 300 US-Dollar'.
Brand/tool names kept literal: Clio, Twilio, Calendly, n8n, Make. Unsplash image URLs unchanged. Cited source kept: Clio 2024 Legal Trends Report.
No em-dashes in body prose; commas and rewrites used. The — entities inside the data table were kept as-is because they are the source's placeholder dashes for 'no data', not sentence em-dashes.
Internal same-site links repointed to /de (industries, services, blog, case-studies, contact). /privacy, /terms, sitemap, mailto, tel and external URLs left unchanged.
Language switcher rebuilt as three-way with EN + ES links and DE current.
No lead/audit form on this page, so no window.__i18n form block was added.
'You own everything we build' rendered as the fixed glossary phrase 'Dir gehört alles, was wir bauen.'
